authority_note: This is 10x metric contract and evidence index, NOT the canonical v27 delivery ledger and not financial/accounting system
privacy_policy: No personal identifiers, raw analytics, customer records, broker positions, purchase receipts, account numbers, keys or payment provider credentials. Financial revenue proofs remain private and external.
causality_note: PR opened-to-merged includes waiting, CI, human review; never infer active effort, speedup or 10x causality from it

metrics.definition: Verified product feature per measured week
metrics.acceptance: Product PR + exact-head CI + acceptance receipt; docs and audits do not count

metrics.definition: Request→first actual coding→verified delivery, with active time separately
metrics.acceptance: Independent work timestamp evidence; PR open→merge is elapsed lifecycle, not labor
Observed manual interactions per shipped verified product feature

metrics.definition: Verified reused components in shipped feature set
metrics.acceptance: Adoption tested in consumer and release, no inferred Golden promotion
Reproduced issue with release SHA and subsequent diagnosis

metrics.definition: D30 retained cohort for consented product
metrics.acceptance: Anonymized aggregate cohort, privacy and consent review, no raw user data

metrics.definition: Revenue after platform costs, aggregated for a product
metrics.acceptance: Private provider/accounting source, never personal transaction details in public repo
Actual runner receipts and retry events on two independent consumers
